description: This file defines the Source class in Twig, which encapsulates information about a non-compiled Twig template, including its code, name, and file path.

classes.name: Twig\Source
classes.description: A class representing the source of a Twig template, holding its code, name, and optional filesystem path.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Source instance with template code, name, and optional path.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the source code of the template.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the logical name of the template.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the filesystem path of the template, if any.
